name: uve been funked
author: PixelLolka
description: Don't click when entering the ufo portal at 50% to fall above the level. Stay a bit above the gameplay until 60%, where you are teleported back into the level. Skip both blue orbs at 61% and then maintain a constant position until 70%. Start spamming at 71% to go above the level. Stay at a constant position until 83%, where you'll be teleported back into the level. | Buffer a hold when you enter the wave portal at 87% to go above the level. Hold to the end from there.
